r2_dependency: Use the retained r2 motif and progression eligibility only when analysis-repair-pass.

repair_policy.eligible: Every available initial parse or musical-contract failure, including a named sentinel.
repair_policy.feedback: Return only the structured parse or failed-check diagnostic.
repair_policy.primary_result: Initial musical success only. A repair never replaces an initial result.
repair_policy.unavailable_or_failed: Do not repair and do not add to a scored denominator.
